liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Standing On The Moon** (6 reviews): Jerry played it cleanly, redeeming earlier flubs; the reviewer thought it possibly the tour's highlight; Reviewer considers this version the benchmark against which other performances of the song are measured [14][16][17][18][19][22]
- **High Time** (1 review): High Time is singled out as a nice treat in the first set [16]
- **Rain** (1 review): The Rain encore was outstanding, according to this listener [22]
- **I Need A Miracle** (1 other source): The space segment following the song is included within the I Need A Miracle track [1]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd93-09-26 s1 t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd93-09-26 s1 t02 Jack Straw**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd93-09-26 s1 t03 Althea**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd93-09-26 s1 t04 Walkin' Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd93-09-26 s1 t05 High Time**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd93-09-26 s1 t06 Me & My Uncle**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd93-09-26 s1 t07 Maggie's Farm**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd93-09-26 s1 t08 Lazy River Road**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-09-26.140093.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.gastwirt.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 149 min [1]
- **gd93-09-26.schoeps.pujol.13990.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 147 min; rated 4.08/5 by 12 [6]. Said about its sound: Prefers this audience recording to the Nak version, with Phil more prominent; Reviewer feels Garden shows rarely sound as good on audience tapes as on clean soundboards, yet this is worth downloading [16][24]
- **gd1993-09-26.neumann-birkhead.koucky.87812.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 148 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1993-09-26.110432.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 150 min [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer believes Bobby began playing acoustic guitar at this show, though unsure [14]
- A headbanger front row center moved to the music all night, even through mellow songs, puzzling nearby fans [17]
- Seated behind the band, reviewer watched a front-row headbanger and noted the crowd's high energy [19]
- Attendee recalls a thunderous sound that made the old Garden shake [22]
- This was the second night of the stand; the reviewer met a friend in the lot behind the Garden [23]
- Weir played acoustic guitar for Me & My Uncle into Maggie's Farm [1]
- Reviewer ranks this Standing On The Moon above the one from Eugene in 1993 [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-09-26.140093.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.gastwirt.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Rich Gastwirt; transferred by Charlie Miller and Scott Clugston; source: Rich Gastwirt's Master Audience Dat 16/48; Schoeps CMC4/MK4 -> Oade P/S -> Panasonic SV-255 [1]
- **gd93-09-26.schoeps.pujol.13990.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Dave Minor; transferred by Marc Pujol; source: Audience: Schoeps [6]
- **gd1993-09-26.neumann-birkhead.koucky.87812.flac16**: taped by Jim Birkhead; transferred by Bill Koucky; source: Neumann km 82i > Sonosax SX-PR power supply > Sony TCD D10 PRO II DAT x1 [2]
- **gd1993-09-26.110432.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Alan Schmit; transferred by Terry Watts; source: Source: (handheld/ORTF/110^/DFC/FOB) B&K 4011s > Neumann BS48i-2 > SV-255 > DAT(m) [3]
